notes.title: Lipsync control for each avatar in Dan Sing Sing 4.7

Quote from his suggestion
[b]The only time Lip Sync can be enabled or disabled is through Camera......But the effect that I want to do is two people talking. So if Character A is lipsyncing in Camera A, I want Character B to NOT Lipsync in Camera A[/b]
